**D**

`package-info.java` is a generic Java file that can appear in any of these modules, so the file name alone cannot settle it. I chose hadoop-hdfs because it is by far the largest module (715 files) and has many packages, which makes it the most likely place for such a file. Option B (hadoop-huaweicloud) is also plausible, since its small source tree likely includes one.
